facts.claim: Anatomy indexed from 'Digital Anatomy of Four Music-Marketing Machines' research report (2026-10-03); per-fact evidence tiers and sources recorded in attrs.key_facts
Cross-artist acceptance-rate dataset (which curators accept which micro-genres at what rates) and curator reliability scores - the platforms' private compounding data moat; not rebuildable

The vetted curator network itself: thousands of relationships, historical acceptance/reliability data, tiering; the SLA/refund trust infrastructure - you cannot conjure 3,000 responsive curators with track records
Artists see only their own campaign dashboards; curators see only their queues; all submission, decision, feedback, pricing-tier, and reputation data lives on each platform's own servers
